race.comment: YES I BELIEVE (8) won well two back before being left with too much to do over this track and trip last time out, missing by 0.2L as the favourite. The form out of it has been very strong though and he comes here with 35 days between runs. Drawn well and can play a leading role again. WESTERN IMPACT (5) was too good last start when winning by 0.7L when running over the top from the back of the pack. Faithfull remains in the saddle from a good draw today and if he can run up to that effort, he can get the job done. IRONCLAD BOY (3) is building towards a win with placings at his last two runs, the latest effort a third over 1400m at this track when beaten 2.25 lengths. Yet to win this track and distance but has recorded three minor placings from four attempts. Has claims on his best efforts. ALMA MATER (9) sat on the pace and stuck on well to score by a head at this track and trip last start in a far better effort. Looks well placed so expect another big run. KUNAPIPI (11) is next best.
